title: Natural tensor-model adjunction compatible with open restriction
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an arbitrary open, and choose the derived categories of module sheaves on $X$, on every over-site over an open, and on $U$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $A\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, $P$ a K-flat integer-indexed cochain complex [def-pc-kflat-complex], and $e_A:Q(P)\simeq A$. Let $R$ be derived over-site restriction followed by the canonical over equivalence [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]. For every complex $J$ put $B_J=Q(\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes J))$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], and for every derived object $E$ put $H_E=R\mathcal Hom(A,E)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. There exist families of equivalences $t_{J,E}:\operatorname{Hom}(Q(J),H_E)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(B_J,E)$ and $r_{J,E}:\operatorname{Hom}(R(Q(J)),R(H_E))\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(R(B_J),R(E))$. They satisfy $r_{J,E}(R(\xi))=R(t_{J,E}(\xi))$ for every $\xi:Q(J)\to H_E$. For every chain map $u:J\to J\prime$ and every $s:R(Q(J\prime))\to R(H_E)$ they satisfy $r_{J,E}(R(Q(u));s)=R(Q(\mathrm{id}_P\otimes u));r_{J\prime,E}(s)$. The families are simultaneous in $J,E$; no K-flatness of $J$, augmentation, representative equation, or invertibility is assumed.

source.place: Tag 08DJ, equation-internal-hom and lemma-internal-hom; Tag 08DL, lemma-restriction-RHom-to-U; their representative evaluation and naturality

proof.text: Obtain coherent tensor-model object isomorphisms c_J, d_J and h_E with the restriction evaluation identity and tensor naturality.

Compose the global canonical Hom equivalence with Iso.homCongr for c_J.symm to define t. Compose Iso.homCongr for h_E, the canonical Hom equivalence on U, and Iso.homCongr for d_J.symm to define r. The inverse isomorphisms make these genuine equivalences. Expanding the three compositions gives the restriction equality from the comparison evaluation identity.

Specialize canonical adjunction naturality to identity maps in the second and third variables. The image of the pair of identities is the identity. For precomposition by R(Q(u)), associate composites, use this specialization, and then the naturality equation for d. This proves the second displayed equation. The generic private transport proof handles zero complexes and empty opens without exceptions.

theorem exists_tensorModel_restriction_adjunction
    (X : Scheme.{uX}) (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (A : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P)
    (eA : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ A) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf
    letI := (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed X.sheaf).1.some
    let R := ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory
    let H := fun E ↦ (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace)
      X.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj (op A, E)
    let B := fun J ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P J (curriedTensor _))
    ∃ (t : ∀ J E, (DerivedCategory.Q.obj J ⟶ H E) ≃ (B J ⟶ E))
      (r : ∀ J E, (R.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj J) ⟶ R.obj (H E)) ≃
        (R.obj (B J) ⟶ R.obj E)),
      (∀ J E (ξ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj J ⟶ H E),
        r J E (R.map ξ) = R.map (t J E ξ)) ∧
      (∀ J J' E (u : J ⟶ J')
        (s : R.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj J') ⟶ R.obj (H E)),
        r J E (R.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map u) ≫ s) =
          R.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map
            (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap (𝟙 P) u (curriedTensor _)
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) ≫ r J' E s)
